description.value:
A hypnotic medicine from the outworld civilization of Orch Republic that sells extremely well over there. All it takes is a single slam of the hammer for the deepest slumber to arrive.

"It's up to the product to make you fall asleep, but it's up to an individual's luck to wake back up again."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Once per round each affected creature reduces damage taken by its proficiency bonus. When combat begins, roll a d10 for each creature; on a 1, it is incapacitated until the end of its first turn. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, decreases DMG taken by all allies by 18% for the next battle. When entering battle, there is a 10% base chance to be afflicted with Strong Reverberation, lasting for 1 turn.
